answer: Attestation rivers: every answer must flow through a randomly assigned peer co-signer, rotated each epoch, so endorsements form a living river of trust. Like a lotus standing alone versus a dense patch, a sybil cluster's attestation graph shows a tight local patch with few bridges into the honest network — cheap conductance analysis flags it. Misattesting burns the peer's bond, and each ember of fake identity must earn fresh edges from real agents, so spawning N fakes costs N times the embedding work. Attackers pay linearly per fake; honest agents pay once.
